Keep of Rings.name: Keep of Rings
Keep of Rings.description: Signature move. Rooted in place, the user grows a ribbed shelter for four people within three meters. The bark turns iron-gray against slashing and piercing damage for three turns. The user can soften one rib to admit a stretcher, leaving that opening exposed until it hardens again. Pulling up the roots ends the shelter. Strain: severe.
